description: August 21 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 21 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: The August 21 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: In the closing days of Leo season, the 21st of August pairs the Sun's twenty-eighth degree with the expressive number 3. Mars sub-rules the decan, lending energy to creativity. People born today are often pictured as vivid performers or persuasive speakers, playful yet driven. A hint of Virgo's precision, just ahead, may already show in their craft.

Astronomically, August 21 puts the Sun near 28° Leo in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mars. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for August 21
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an August 21 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous August 21 birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 21 is the 233rd day of the year (234th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Virgo, is usually complete within 2 days, by August 23.

By August 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an August 21 birthday are Usain Bolt (1986), Robert Lewandowski (1988) and Mohammed VI of Morocco (1963).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 21?
faq.answer: August 21 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 21 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 21?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 21?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on August 21 include Usain Bolt (1986), Robert Lewandowski (1988) and Mohammed VI of Morocco (1963). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
